name: food-delivery
description: Система управления заказами и доставкой еды для ресторанов

scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run test
scripts.build: npm run build -w @food-delivery/shared && npm run build -w @food-delivery/service-kit && npm run build -w @food-delivery/contracts && npm run build -w @food-delivery/catalog && npm run build -w @food-delivery/order && npm run build -w @food-delivery/payment && npm run build -w @food-delivery/delivery && npm run build -w @food-delivery/gateway
scripts.test: npm run test -w @food-delivery/shared && npm run test -w @food-delivery/service-kit && npm run test -w @food-delivery/catalog && npm run test -w @food-delivery/order && npm run test -w @food-delivery/payment && npm run test -w @food-delivery/delivery && npm run test -w @food-delivery/gateway
scripts.test:cov: npm run test:cov -w @food-delivery/shared && npm run test:cov -w @food-delivery/service-kit && npm run test:cov -w @food-delivery/catalog && npm run test:cov -w @food-delivery/order && npm run test:cov -w @food-delivery/payment && npm run test:cov -w @food-delivery/delivery && npm run test:cov -w @food-delivery/gateway
scripts.db:reset: npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
